name: Sync upstream OE4T branches

# Scheduled workflows only run from the default branch. Keep this file on
# `main` (NVIDIA control branch) and set `main` as the repository default.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/5 * * * *" # every 5 minutes
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: sync-upstream
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch upstream OE4T
        run: |
          git remote add upstream https://github.com/OE4T/tegra-kernel-cache.git 2>/dev/null || \
            git remote set-url upstream https://github.com/OE4T/tegra-kernel-cache.git
          git fetch upstream --prune
          git fetch origin --prune

      - name: Mirror allowlisted upstream branches to origin
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # tegra-kernel-cache uses kernel-series branch names, not Yocto
          # release names. Keep NVIDIA-only branches (`main`, `*-nvidia`,
          # `master+*`) out of this list.
          BRANCHES=(
            yocto-6.18
          )

          synced=0
          skipped=0
          created=0
          updated=0

          for branch in "${BRANCHES[@]}"; do
            if ! git rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/upstream/${branch}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "missing upstream: ${branch}"
              skipped=$((skipped + 1))
              continue
            fi

            upstream_sha="$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/upstream/${branch}")"

            if ! git rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/${branch}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "create: ${branch} -> ${upstream_sha}"
              git push origin "refs/remotes/upstream/${branch}:refs/heads/${branch}"
              created=$((created + 1))
              synced=$((synced + 1))
              continue
            fi

            origin_sha="$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/${branch}")"
            if [[ "${origin_sha}" == "${upstream_sha}" ]]; then
              echo "up-to-date: ${branch}"
              skipped=$((skipped + 1))
              continue
            fi

            if git merge-base --is-ancestor "${origin_sha}" "${upstream_sha}"; then
              echo "fast-forward: ${branch} ${origin_sha:0:8}..${upstream_sha:0:8}"
              git push origin "refs/remotes/upstream/${branch}:refs/heads/${branch}"
            else
              # Mirror policy: OE4T is source of truth for shared branch names.
              echo "force-with-lease (diverged mirror): ${branch} ${origin_sha:0:8}..${upstream_sha:0:8}"
              git push --force-with-lease="refs/heads/${branch}:${origin_sha}" \
                origin "refs/remotes/upstream/${branch}:refs/heads/${branch}"
            fi
            updated=$((updated + 1))
            synced=$((synced + 1))
          done

          echo "summary: synced=${synced} created=${created} updated=${updated} skipped=${skipped}"

# NVIDIA tegra-kernel-cache (control branch)

This `main` branch is the **NVIDIA control branch** for [NVIDIA/tegra-kernel-cache](https://github.com/NVIDIA/tegra-kernel-cache).

It is intentionally separate from OE4T content branches (`yocto-*` kernel-series lines).

## Purpose

- Host GitHub Actions that keep OE4T branches mirrored into this fork
- Remain the repository **default branch** so scheduled workflows can run
- Never receive OE4T content syncs (protected by the sync workflow)

## Branch policy

| Branch | Role |
|--------|------|
| `main` | NVIDIA control (this branch); Actions only |
| `yocto-6.18` | Allowlisted mirror of [OE4T/tegra-kernel-cache](https://github.com/OE4T/tegra-kernel-cache) |

OE4T currently publishes only `yocto-6.18` on this repository (no Yocto release-name branches like `master` / `wrynose`).

## Sync workflow

`.github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml` runs every 5 minutes (and on manual dispatch) and mirrors only the allowlisted OE4T branches above. Edit the `BRANCHES` array in that workflow when OE4T adds new `yocto-*` lines.

After pushing this branch, set **Settings → General → Default branch** to `main`.
